input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, exclusion of damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere: the Warranties article (Section 9, p0055 onwards) and the General Provisions (Section 10) are silent on caps, and the only "liability" reference is the No Joint Venture provision. Both Parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct and consequential liability, failing even the fallback. We insert a new Section 10.9 in the General Provisions setting a mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, a mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion, uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirming that Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim by the Company to HDI under this Agreement and (b) USD 1,000,000, and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect or consequential damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Customer's payment obligations, being all amounts due from the Company under this Agreement, are not "damages" for purposes of this Section 10.9.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no limitation of liability, leaving both Parties exposed to unlimited and consequential damages; we added a mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.
proposal.summary: Add a mutual limitation of liability clause with standard uncapped carve-outs
